title: Kaleidoscope
studio_context: Co-produced with Nigel Gray; his first album with the band, synthesizers and drum machines on a few tracks, his kit on the rest.

drum_performances.name: Budgie
drum_performances.why_it_matters: Happy House, his first record with them: the floor tom in sixteenths over four on the floor, 'a reggae vibe' from a drummer 'interested in African polyrhythms'; Christine's kick on the 'and's.

evidence.note: He plays on tracks 1-5 and 7-11; Lunar Camel (6) is synthesizers.
